speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your chronic cough, weight loss, and weakness, please tell me your age and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms. Additionally, have you noticed any blood in your sputum or fevers at night?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis.

The combination of your chronic cough, significant weight loss, night sweats, fever, and history of recent incarceration is highly suggestive of active pulmonary tuberculosis. I want to confirm if you have had any contact with others who had a cough or respiratory illness. Do you have any known health conditions like diabetes or HIV that might affect your immune system?
